newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chase retained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chase retained as buy.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harrman analyst Raphael Soifer said he maintained a trading buy rating on Chase Manhattan Corp but increased the 1997 earnings estimate to $8.75 per share from $8.35 to take into account an expected acclerated pace of share repurchases and the replacement of preferred stock with tax-deductible trust preferred
-- Investment ratings of market perform for horizons of 12 months and hold for three mnmth horizons are also retained
-- Chase Manhattan up 3/8 to 92-3/4 in early trading
